title: ChefGPT Doc Chatbot
tagline: AI chatbot to integrate with technical documentation. Answers questions about docs links to points in docs for more info.
description: ChefGPT is trained on context from the docs and whitepaper of the integrated chain or protocol. For this submission, we are using Linea. ChefGPT answers questions about Linea and provides links to the portion of the docs relevant to the answer so the user can learn more. Additionally, there are suggested prompt questions for users to ask and learn more about Linea through this chat bot.
how_its_made:
ChefGPT stands as an avant-garde integration of AI into documentation and whitepaper analysis. This initiative showcases the potential of AI in elevating user experience and streamlining the accessibility of information.

Integration with Linea Documentation:

ChefGPT is intricately integrated into a custom-forked version of the Linea documentation. This integration transcends the mere addition of an AI tool into an existing framework, creating a harmonious blend where ChefGPT augments and significantly enriches the Linea documentation experience.

Deployment on Staging Site:

To guarantee thorough testing and gather insightful feedback, ChefGPT is deployed on a staging site. This approach allows for real-world environment emulation, offering critical insights into user interactions and system performance in diverse scenarios.

Contextual Understanding with 128k Context:

A standout feature of ChefGPT is its profound ability to comprehend and interpret the context within Linea's documentation and whitepapers, bolstered by a 128k context limit. This enhanced context window enables ChefGPT to grasp and respond to queries with a deeper understanding of extensive documentation, ensuring relevant and context-rich assistance.

Reliance on ChatGPT-4 API:

ChefGPT's core functionality is powered by the sophisticated ChatGPT-4 API from OpenAI. This technology selection capitalizes on the advanced language model's prowess in understanding, generating, and processing human language. The ChatGPT-4 API, with its extensive capabilities, furnishes ChefGPT with a robust and intelligent framework for user interactions.

Objective and Future Scope:

The aim of ChefGPT is to transform user interaction with technical documentation and whitepapers. Integrating AI into these essential resources, we strive to amplify accessibility, minimize the learning curve, and provide immediate, context-aware support. Moving forward, our vision is to continually evolve ChefGPT, integrating user feedback and emerging technologies to further refine its effectiveness.
